Reload conf file.

## Synopsis

```text
reload
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Re-reads the configuration; a configuration with errors is refused and the running one stays.

## Examples

Apply edited configuration files without restarting odir:

```text
reload
```
